name: LSF0108BQ-Q100X
title: LSF0108-Q100: automotive 8-channel two-way level translator, no direction pin, for open-drain or push-pull signals
summary: Eight pass channels, each a switch between an A pin and a B pin, translate logic levels in either direction with no direction control; two reference pins, refA and refB, set the two sides' levels. It works with open-drain and push-pull signals, translating up to 100 MHz upward and 100 MHz or more downward into 30 pF. EN high closes all channels, EN low leaves every data pin high-impedance. Qualified to AEC-Q100 Grade 1 (-40 °C to +125 °C), in TSSOP20 (LSF0108PW-Q100) or a 2.5 × 4.5 mm DHVQFN20 with side-wettable flanks (LSF0108BQ-Q100).

circuits.title: Test circuit for measuring RON
circuits.description: Bench setup for the ON-resistance figures. A source VrefA drives refA; refB and EN share a node pulled to Vpu through 200 kΩ and held by 100 nF to ground, so the channel is on. A source VI holds An, and a current source forces IO into Bn; RON follows from the An to Bn drop at that current.
notes: A1 and B1 stand for any channel's An and Bn; the two may be swapped.

circuits.title: Test circuit for measuring switching times
circuits.description: Bench setup for the propagation delays. Supplies and enable are as in the RON setup: VrefA on refA, refB and EN pulled to Vpu by Rpu and decoupled by CEN. A pulse generator VI drives An; Bn carries the load capacitance CL and is watched as VO. A switch hangs a load from Bn: in position S1 a resistor RL up to VEXT, used for translating up; in position S2 1 MΩ to ground, used for translating down.

operation.text: Each of the eight channels is a pass switch between An and Bn, so data flows whichever way it is driven and no pin sets direction. With EN high every An follows its Bn; with EN low all sixteen data pins float at high impedance. The pins are laid out flow-through: A1 to A8 on one side, B1 to B8 facing them.

Translation is offered between 0.95 V and any of 1.8, 2.5, 3.3 or 5.0 V; between 1.2 V and any of 1.8, 2.5, 3.3 or 5.0 V; between 1.8 V and 2.5, 3.3 or 5.0 V; between 2.5 V and 3.3 or 5.0 V; and between 3.3 V and 5.0 V. Each channel can be set up for its own pair of levels. Open-drain and push-pull lines are both supported.
Translating up from the low side to the high side reaches 100 MHz with 30 pF of load and 50 MHz with 50 pF. Translating down reaches at least 100 MHz into 30 pF and at least 50 MHz into 50 pF.

operation.topic: Reference pins in the test setups
operation.text: In both bench setups refA takes the low-side reference VrefA directly, while refB and EN are joined and pulled to the high-side supply Vpu through 200 kΩ, with 100 nF from that node to ground. Vpu is set 1 V above VrefA for the switching figures.
Data pins tolerate 5 V, for TTL compatibility, and the part supports hot insertion. Standby current is low. Low RON keeps signal distortion small.
Latch-up withstands more than 100 mA (JESD78, class II, level A). ESD: above 2000 V human body model (ANSI/ESDA/JEDEC JS-001, class 2) and above 1000 V charged device model (JS-002, class C3).
Qualified to AEC-Q100 Grade 1 and specified over -40 °C to +125 °C. The DHVQFN20 has side-wettable flanks, so its solder joints can be checked by automatic optical inspection.
GPIO, MDIO, PMBus, SMBus, SDIO, UART, I2C and similar buses in telecom infrastructure; industrial, personal computing and automotive equipment.
